prompt: The client keeps raising prices and asks whether it should continue. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Units fell only 2% after the first price increase
options.feedback: True, but the latest increase lost 22% of units (90k to 70k) and cut revenue.
Right. Revenue: $1.00M, $1.08M, $1.08M, then $0.91M at $13 as units fell from 90k to 70k.

options.text: Units held up well as prices rose
options.feedback: Units fell from 100k to 70k, most of it in the last year.

options.text: Competitors held their prices, so units fell at $13
options.feedback: The chart shows only the client's price and units. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.
